title: Midway Limited - proposed acquisition of Gunns Limited's wood chip export facilities at the port of Portland
targets: Gunns Limited's wood chip export facilities at the port of Portland

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC terminated public review after Midway advised it was no longer involved in the sale process. Midway withdrew its request for ACCC approval.
